title: Placement decision pipeline
summary: Placement is a two-stage decision: evaluate mandatory eligibility for every candidate, then score only the eligible set. Authoritative admission occurs after ranking and may cause fallback to the next ranked eligible node; admission denial never causes dispatch without reservation.
invariants: An ineligible assessment must never be passed to the scorer.
Admission denial removes that candidate from the current placement attempt; it does not soften eligibility.
Deterministic ranking is score-descending with node-id tie breaking.
